expects.rule: Each property or unit shows price (or a payment schedule), size, number of rooms and location as text next to the photographs.
An enquiry or call-back button is in the header and in the hero, and the form asks only for name, contact and a message.
Phone and sales-office address are plain text, and the phone number is a tap-to-call link.
Location is explained with a map and travel times to named places (station, school, airport).
Floor plans and documents (permit, brochure) are linked as files with their size, and the key facts are also in the page text.
The site states who the developer, architect and agent are, and the status (under construction, available).
Listings can be filtered by price, size and rooms, and show availability.

traits: 4 of 8 fill the first screen with one photograph, render or video (Lenval, Mejuma, Rialto, Kononenko); the name or one short headline sits at the bottom or centre.
3 of 8 were still on a loader or intro at capture (Belgrade Arbor, ERA Residence, Storey), and 2 more had a cookie panel over the picture (Lenval, Mejuma).
6 of 8 pair a serif or display face with a plain sans (Belgrade, Concrete, Lenval, Mejuma, ERA, Kononenko); Rialto sets headlines in a condensed grotesque.
Backgrounds are cream or white on 5 of 8 and near-black on 3 (Concrete #141416, Lenval #211a19, Rialto #080808); no site uses more than one accent colour.
An enquiry control sits in the top bar of 3 of 8 (Inquire, Let's Talk, Demander une estimation); Rialto has Portal Login and Contact.
2 of 8 hide the main links behind a Menu control (Belgrade, Mejuma); Kononenko shows four links and Rialto six.
Key figures are written as numbers where the site states them (25 residences, 104 to 244 m2, 600M EUR, EUR 185,000 to 700,000); only Mejuma shows prices.
3 of 8 offer more than one language (Concrete FR/EN, Mejuma en/nl/de, Belgrade en/rs).

sites.name: Belgrade Arbor
sites.why: At capture the first screen was an empty cream (#fdfbef) page with two thin vertical lines, a dark green pill bar (Menu, logo, Inquire) and a Site of the Day tab: a loading intro. Work Sans and a serif for the 134 px name. Menu of nine entries, payment schedule in percentages. No unit prices.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award, 2026-10-17

sites.name: Concrete (Concrete Management)
sites.why: Dark (#141416) first screen caught on an intro: wordmark and two tall interior photographs, Paris and Lausanne, with arrow buttons. The page then gives headline 'L'immobilier, pensé pour vous', four figures (600M EUR managed, 4.8/5), a Demander une estimation button, FR/EN switch.

sites.name: Lenval Properties
sites.why: Full-screen video of a car and palms with the serif headline 'Creators of Refined Living & Iconic Spaces' bottom centre, three links left, logo centre, Let's Talk right, a cookie box bottom left. Financier Display with Helvetica Now. Featured project Project J on Jubail Island lower.

sites.name: Mejuma Tuscany
sites.why: Aerial photograph of a Tuscan farm under a huge white serif wordmark, a three-line intro sentence, Menu button top right and a cookie panel down the right. Golos Text with a display serif. Four listing cards lower with price range, place and area (EUR 185,000 to 700,000).

sites.name: Rialto (Melbourne)
sites.why: Night aerial video of towers with a blue neon outline, a split nav around the logo (Discover, What's On, Experience / Leasing, About, Contact), a blue (#004bff) Portal Login button and a condensed capital headline 'Celebrating 40 years'. Gotham and Sharp Grotesk. Address and phone lower.

sites.name: ERA Residence (Estepona)
sites.why: At capture a plum-coloured intro screen: logo, stacked name ERA Residence in condensed serif with a script 'Estepona', 'Costa del Sol' either side, a one-line tagline. The page then offers Select an Apartment, facts (25 residences, 104 to 244 m2), developer named. No prices.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day 2026-08-31, Site of the Month August 2026, Developer Award

sites.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
sites.why: Architectural render of a metal-clad building under a cloudy sky fills the screen; the name in a grotesque and a serif sits bottom left, four links (Index, Work, About, Contact) top right. Eight project cards with area lower, two office addresses and weekday hours in the footer.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award, 2026-08-23

sites.name: Storey Architecture (Exeter)
sites.why: The screenshot caught a black loading screen with the name and a spinner. The page then has white (#ffffff) ground, New Grotesk with a mono, cycling hero images, email and phone in the menu, a project row, and a contact form asking project type, location and timeline.

avoid: A loading counter or intro animation that delays the first view of the property by several seconds.
A site that asks the visitor to rotate the device to portrait mode.
Properties shown only as renders, with no price, size or availability anywhere.
A contact button that does not lead anywhere (link to '#').
Stock photographs of generic interiors in place of the actual project.
A map pin with no address or travel times.
Brochures and floor plans only as heavy PDFs with no text version of the key facts.
